prior_matched_160k_optimization.comparison_warning: These percentages are the existing matched single-query comparisons, not recomputed from the new five-query median. Temi and Semi use different compatible fields and preprocessing protocols.

scope_warning: All MPC parties ran on one physical host. The 160k fixture is favorable, synthetic, degree one, and uses only one relation pair. The owner sweep is small and synthetic. These experiments strengthen correctness, repeatability, protocol-optimization, and controlled owner-scaling evidence; they do not establish full-CWQ, dense-graph, physical-WAN, or GORAM-level scalability.
